pull.title: coins: avoid redundant prevout preparation allocations
pull.body:
**Problem:** Block preparation inserts an unused final transaction ID, repeatedly constructs salted transaction-ID sets, and allocates a worker-task vector. Small input queues also submit more tasks than can do useful work.

**Fix:** Insert each transaction ID before scanning the following transaction's inputs. Reuse the set's buckets and hash salt and the worker-task vector across blocks. Limit submitted tasks to the smaller of the worker and queued-input counts.

coins: omit final txid from prevout classification

Insert each transaction ID before scanning the following transaction's inputs, omitting the unused final ID.
This reduces txid insertions from N to N-1 and replaces the separate coinbase seed and trailing insertion with one insertion at the start of the loop.

coins: cap prevout tasks at the input count

Each task drains the shared input queue, so tasks beyond the number of inputs cannot do useful work.
For an empty queue, submit an empty range and skip the worker notification inside `ThreadPool::Submit` instead of guarding submission at the caller.
